top_signals.title: BlackRock’s ‘Widow Maker’ Treasury ETF Slides to 2004 Low
top_signals.summary: The rout in longer-dated US Treasuries has sent a popular BlackRock Inc. exchange-traded fund tumbling to its lowest level in over two decades, as concerns around sticky inflation continue battering fixed-income portfolios.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Google Earth AI tool pulled after spate of fake satellite images
top_signals.summary: Security experts say generative tools risk eroding trust in satellite images used to verify conflict damage and incidents
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Budget to move “power and money out of Westminster, and into every postcode around Britain”.
top_signals.summary: Today (Friday 31 July), the Chancellor has confirmed that the date of the Budget will be Wednesday 28 October.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Brazil Traders Left Scrambling as Hours-Long Halt Hits Exchange
top_signals.summary: For more than three hours on Friday morning, traders in Sao Paulo’s financial district scrambled to understand why feeds from Brazil’s main exchange were all blank well past opening time.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft added nearly $1.5 trillion in combined value this week
top_signals.summary: Amazon, Microsoft and Google added hundreds of billions of dollars to their market caps, while Apple and Meta saw their market valuations fall.
